description: This file contains unit tests for the LDAPTestService class in the OrangeHRM project. It tests various LDAP connection scenarios including success, failure due to invalid credentials, invalid host, port, and encryption settings, as well as anonymous connection attempts.

classes.name: LDAPTestServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LDAPTestService functionalities within the OrangeHRM LDAP plugin, focusing on LDAP connection validation under various scenarios.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Sets up LDAP server configuration before any tests run; skips tests if LDAP server is not configured.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initial setup before each test, ensuring server configuration and data load.

methods.name: configureServerAndLoadData
methods.description: Mocks config service, authenticates with LDAP, disables anonymous binding, sets page size, and loads fixture data.

methods.name: testConnection
methods.description: Tests successful LDAP connection with configured admin credentials.

methods.name: testAnonymousConnection
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection as anonymous user, expecting a ConnectionException.

methods.name: testInvalidUserName
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection with invalid user DN, expecting an InvalidCredentialsException.

methods.name: testInvalidUserNameSyntax
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection with syntactically invalid DN, expecting a ConnectionException.

methods.name: testInvalidPassword
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection with invalid password, expecting an InvalidCredentialsException.

methods.name: testInvalidHost
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection with unreachable host, expecting a ConnectionException.

methods.name: testInvalidPort
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection with incorrect port, expecting a ConnectionException.

methods.name: testEncryptionWithPort
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection with SSL encryption over default port, expecting a ConnectionException.
